name: Alastir
desc: Alastir is a Celtor NPC. He is a Pathfinder who was on [Erisia](location:erisia) before it drifted into the [Voidsea](location:voidsea).
additional_info:
-   You can turn in [Navaen Hostages](entity:navaen_hostage) you find for the same effect.
-   His aspect was also originally Adret rather than Celtor.
goals: Take in survivors rescued from [Duke Erisia](entity:duke_ishamon_erisia)'s golems
